name: Sunset Sherbet - Infused Ice Packs (Rosin, Hash, and Diamonds) 1g
description:
Rove Ice Packs prerolls, the world’s first triple-infused preroll. Made with premium-grade flower fully-infused with THCA diamonds and solventless ice hash rosin, expertly rolled and coated in more ice hash. Super smooth and ultra potent, Rove Ice Packs test up to 50% THC. Welcome to the next evolution of prerolls.

Sunset Sherbet
Sunset Sherbet brings together ripe berry, tangy citrus, and deep earthy notes in a smooth, layered profile. Bright on the first hit, mellowing into a rounder, earthier finish. A well-balanced strain for those who want flavor complexity without the sweetness overload.
